Try to get an appointment - you will be told a weeks wait if you are lucky. They will tell you to call each morning at 8am - most times you will be told the queue is full via automated response and cut off. Today I called at 8am and after being rejected three times by said automated message, was lucky enough to get onto the actual queue (position 30) waited and waited and finally got through. No appointments for today, next one in a weeks time, or call back tomorrow at 8am for an on the day appointment, and so the charade continues...
On another note, if you are waiting for test results do not expect them to call you with them, even if there is something wrong. The results will have been sent to an app (that you are not told you need to check yourself).
